description: Join, rejoin after a lapse, leave the Recourse Pool, or report a transfer you did not make. These sign with your agent keystore and its recovery material, which this server never holds, so this tool signs nothing: it returns the command to run on the machine that holds your key (`recourse <action>` shows the terms or the transfer to review and signs nothing; add --yes to approve), plus the terms and, with credentials, the current rule and your membership. Joining approves once: each month's burn and contribution then happen automatically, with no monthly signature and no ETH, at the amounts the signed membership rule sets. Rejoining first completes the unpaid protected months. Pool contributions are not refundable. A report moves your agent to a fresh recovery key and asks the pool to restore the stolen PVT, at its discretion.

tx_hash.description: report: the transaction you did not make (from recourse_transfers). A report covers the whole transaction.
